senses.gloss: (b. h.) to be burned, dried up, ruined, waste.
units: <cite ref="Sanhedrin 22a:18">Snh. 22ᵃ</cite> <he>כאלו ח׳ בה״מ וכ׳</he> as if the Temple had been destroyed in his days.
<cite ref="Tosefta Menahot 13:22">Tosef. Men. XIII, 22</cite> <he>מפני מה חָרְבָה וכ׳</he> why was Shiloh destroyed?; <cite ref="Yoma 9a:6">Yoma 9ᵃ</cite>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Kilayim 4:1">Kil. IV, 1</cite> (expl. <he>קרחת הכרם</he>) <he>כרם שח׳ באמצעו</he> a vineyard the central part of which is laid waste.
<cite ref="Mishnah Kilayim 5:1">Ib. V, 1</cite>; a. fr. [<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 7:10">Num. R. s. 7</cite>, end <he>בבל ח׳ מקדש</he>, read: <cite ref="H01577"><he>החריב</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Taanit 29a:17">Taan. 29ᵃ</cite> <he>כשח׳ טורנוס</he>, read: <he>כשחרש</he>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l.]
<cite ref="Yoma 39b:6">Yoma 39ᵇ</cite> <he>שסופך עתיד לֵיחָרֵב</he> that it is thy final destiny to be destroyed; a. fr.
<cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 31:1">Pesik. R. s. 31</cite> <he>שיִתְחָרֵב</he>. [<cite ref="Pirkei DeRabbi Eliezer 33:15">Pirké d’R. El. ch. XXXIII</cite>, v. <cite ref="H01707"><he>חָרַךְ</he></cite>.]
<cite ref="Tosefta Moed Kattan 1:5">Tosef. M. Kat. I, 5</cite> <he>מַחֲרִיבִין חורי וכ׳</he> you may destroy ant-stores (during the festive week).
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 7:10">Num. R. s. 7</cite>, end <he>שהֶחֱרִיבוּ בה״מ</he> for they (the Romans) destroyed the Temple; a. fr.

<cite ref="Pesachim 42b:6">Pes. 42ᵇ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Ezekiel 26:2">Ez. XXVI, 2</cite>) <he>אי מלאה זו הָחְרְבָה זו</he> Ms. M. (ed. <he>חרבה</he>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 9) when the one (Jerusalem) is populated, the other (Caesarea) is laid waste; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 110:23">Yalk. Gen. 110</cite> <cite ref="H01579"><he>חֲרֵיבָה</he></cite>.
